tips.text: Start the Bio Lab research timers first, Mutagen Mass before Torid, and keep a Mutagen Mass craft running while you wait.
Expect nine days of research if your clan has none of it done; each step is a separate three-day timer.
Check your Plastids and Control Modules before queuing Mutagen Mass; each craft eats them.
Players only get the Acrid for mastery, and the only complaint is that the work is waiting on timers.
